title: A Review on Stability Analysis of Roadbed Slope and Prevention Technologies
content: Road is an important infrastructure for national economic and social development, and roadbed slope stability as one of the most prominent engineering problems of the road, it is of great sig-nificance to assess and analyze the stability and prevention of roadbed slopes. In order to further promote the development of roadbed slope stability and prevention engineering, improve the design level of road engineering slope engineering disaster management project, and reduce the cost of engineering investment, this paper starts from the category of roadbed slope damage form, respectively, for the research method of slope stability, slope stability influencing factors, and slope damage prevention and control measures to carry out a review, and based on the current status of the research on the future direction of the research outlook. It is found that: the damage forms of roadbed slopes are roughly divided into four categories: landslide, avalanche, slump, and spalling; the field test is the most accurate and practical means of evaluating slope stability research; the current analysis of the factors affecting slope stability is too independent, and there is a need to analyze the coupling relationship between the various influencing factors as a whole. In addition, slope damage prevention and control measures for slopes and slopes are summarized. This review helps to better understand the stability of roadbed slopes and prevention measures, realize the efficient prevention and control of slope failure, and provide scientific theoretical guidance for highway slope design.
